blind_spots.blind_spot: No SWaP-C accounting for adding a camera/lens/processing unit inside an already-cramped armored vehicle
blind_spots.operator_reality: JLTV/AMPV interiors have fixed power and space budgets; a DVE add-on with no stated power draw or weight spec gets cut in vehicle integration review before it ever reaches a soldier
blind_spots.why_likely_missing: team is optimizing the 3D algorithm, not vehicle integration constraints
blind_spots.evidence_quote: The software interpolates the incoming video signal, which displays through a lens, and creates the realistic 3D effect.

blind_spots.blind_spot: No ATO/RMF or software certification pathway mentioned for an 'AI software' processing unit destined to run as GFE on Army vehicle networks
blind_spots.operator_reality: Any software touching a JLTV/AMPV data bus needs an ATO/RMF path and likely STIG compliance before a PM will accept it as an ECP — without that, the TRL6 prototype stalls indefinitely regardless of accuracy
blind_spots.why_likely_missing: founders are describing the ECP integration process at a conceptual level, not the certification gauntlet behind it
blind_spots.evidence_quote: Such technology should be applied as an (Engineering Change Proposal (ECP) for legacy DVE systems and integrated into the design of the next generation of DVE systems.

blind_spots.blind_spot: Sustainment/field-repair plan is absent — training is mentioned once, spares/battery/field-fix logistics never
blind_spots.operator_reality: A 2-4 person company has no fielded sustainment infrastructure; when the unit breaks in an austere motor pool, there's no depot-level repair chain, which is exactly what kills small defense-tech vendors post-fielding
blind_spots.why_likely_missing: company is pre-transition and hasn't had to build a sustainment org yet
blind_spots.evidence_quote: Following a small amount of training in the use of the prototype C3D solution, the operator achieves significantly improved night driving terrain awareness
